text_block_list.text:
Following the Kikuka Sho, I speak to<n>Ines Fujin's
mother on the phone.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
My twins are both saying that they<n>want to attend
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I need to visit the hospital, and I've<n>asked my
husband to accompany me.<n>It really shames me
that we can't be<n>there for our daughters...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I want the three of them to get<n>together again and
talk. Could I ask<n>you to help out, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry for involving you in our<n>family affairs...
choice_data_list: It's fine. I'm happy to do what I can for Ines.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much. Please take good<n>care of my
daughters.

Judging from Ines Fujin's behavior<n>and the way
her conversations with<n>her sisters have gone up
until now...

It seems they're a little at odds with<n>each other.
Having me there as a<n>third party might help ease
the<n>tension.

But first, Ines Fujin and I have to<n>decide if she'll
actually be racing in<n>the Arima Kinen or just
spectating.<n>Later, on the day of the race...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh... you're both here.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text:
You're running in the Arima Kinen too,<n>right? Good
luck! I know you're<n>gonna crush 'em!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. I haven't kept any of the<n>promises I
made to you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I still haven't made enough money<n>for you to hire a
helper for a year, and<n>I made you both worry at the
Kikuka<n>Sho...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text: You don't have to apologize. Me and<n>Cassie—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But listen! I promise I'll pull through!<n>Don't worry
about helping out around<n>the house or anything like
that!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
...We're going to. We're going to help<n>out. We
know all about how to do the<n>laundry now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Cassie...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Why?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You're doing too much. You both<n>have dreams of
your own, don't<n>you? You don't have to try and—

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
That's not it! We made up our minds.<n>It's OUR
decision! We're going to<n>stop dancing and help
Mom!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: No... you didn't make thatdecision—you were forced to make it!By me! I gave you no choice!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Why can't you just—
choice_data_list: Maybe you are forcing a decision onto them—but not in the way you think.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
They want to be able to focus on<n>dance practice
every day, and go on<n>to win competitions, and...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: ...You're wrong.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Me and Polly... we just like seeing<n>the whole family
smile.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text:
That's why we like dancing. When<n>we dance,
everyone watches us with<n>big smiles on their
faces. But...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text:
What we like even more than that is<n>watching you
race with all you've<n>got!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text:
We want to see you run a whole lot,<n>and smile a
whole lot, and win a<n>whole lot...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text: That's this whole family's dream<n>right now!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You guys...

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin, it's almost time for you to<n>enter the
paddock!
choice_data_list: Ines, did you hear what your sisters said?
Ines, did you hear what your sisters said?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Then... then what is it?
choice_data_list: It's their dream... and mine too.
It's their dream... and mine too.

text_block_list.text:
It's not just the stands that are<n>packed for today's
Arima Kinen—the<n>paddock's drawn a full crowd too.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Sooo, basically, everyone's come<n>'cause they
wanna see Oguri's last<n>race.

text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know. I mean, Oguri's, like, a<n>super amazing
runner, right? Is that<n>it?

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Well, thing is, she hasn't really been<n>in top form
lately. Rumor has it this<n>could be her last run ever.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oguri! You can do it! I believe in you!<n>You can win!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan B
text_block_list.text: Please, Ogurin! Give it all you've got<n>and win!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Sooo, people are saying this runner<n>called Mejiro
Ryan—who's, like, one<n>of Ines's rivals—might
actually, like,<n>win.

text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa. You know, like, so much<n>about this racing
stuff lately.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. I mean, Ines's races are<n>way more fun
if you know the whole<n>deal.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey girls! I wasn't expecting to<n>see you two
here at the Arima.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
B-Boss! Wh-what about the store?<n>Don't tell me
it's closed?!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Uh, I do employ a lot of part-timers,<n>y'know?
Besides, one day off is no<n>big deal... Wait,
look—she's coming!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Some days I just feel like coming out<n>and seeing
Ines run—watching her<n>really boosts my spirits.
Wooooo!
